Storypane **0.1.0-rc.14** is a release candidate for evaluation.

- Choose **URL folder** or **Organizational folder** in **Content → New folder**. The example page URL updates as you choose a parent and enter a name or slug.
- Find organizational folders by their dashed outline, sectioned folder icon and **Editor only** label. Use them to group regional pages while keeping the locale and nested URL folders in control of the public path.
- Browse the unprefixed default through **Shared**. Select multiple locales next to **Filters** to compare their published paths.

Install the CMS from source tag `v0.1.0-rc.14`. Install the SDK with
`npm install @storypane/sdk@0.1.0-rc.14` or follow `@storypane/sdk@rc`.

Back up databases, original media, configuration and keys before upgrading.
Upgrades from rc.13 use the existing folder storage. See the editor guide for how the two folder types affect page URLs.
